title: Name 5 Things - Kenya Edition
description: Ten seconds, five answers. Count out loud so everyone feels the pressure.
attribution: Written for Mshikaki by the Innovations team

items.prompt: Name 5 mobile money apps or services.
Name 5 football clubs people support here.
Name 5 things you would find in a Kenyan kitchen.
